definitions.explanation: Pay calculated and received based on the number of hours worked.

examples.english: The hourly wage for this part-time job is 1,200 yen.

examples.japanese: {時給|じきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a part-time job with high hourly pay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時給|じきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧25%⟦アップする→アップ：00005_appu⟧。
examples.english: The hourly wage increases 25% during late night hours.

notes:
{時給|じきゅう} is a compound: ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time/hour) + ⟦{給|きゅう}→給：noentry⟧ (pay).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時給|じきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work on an hourly basis)
- {時給|じきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (hourly wage increases)
- {時給|じきゅう}1,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (1,000 yen per hour)
- ⟦{時給制|じきゅうせい}→時給制：noentry⟧ (hourly pay system)

JAPANESE MINIMUM WAGE:
Minimum wage in Japan varies by prefecture. It's set annually and increases gradually. ⟦{最低賃金|さいていちんぎん}→最低賃金：13442_saiteichingin⟧ refers to minimum wage.

USAGE:
⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧ (late-night premium) of 25% applies to hours worked between 10 PM and 5 AM by Japanese labor law.
